crossRefs.note: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high…
They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.
Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to…
and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered…
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many…
But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

translations.web: When they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
translations.bsb: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money
translations.kjv: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
